**Required Scores of English Language Tests**

Please note that applicants who have graduated from an English-speaking country are exempt from the English exam requirement.

The following table presents the equivalent exam scores required for various English proficiency tests (IELTS, IBT) to meet admission criteria for different specializations at the University of Jordan. Each row specifies the minimum required score or range for a particular specialization, along with the institutions where the exams were conducted.

| Specialization                                                                                     | IBT | IELTS                      |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----|----------------------------|
| - High Specialty in Medicine, Dentistry, Doctor of Pharmacy, Veterinary Medicine.                | 90  | 6.5                        |
| - Engineering (All branches).                                                                     |     | British Council (Jordan only) |
| - English Language Specializations (Literature, Translation, Methods of Teaching English Language). |     |                            |
| - Other Specializations of Medicine.                                                               | 69  | 5.5                        |
| - Other Scientific Specializations                                                                  |     | British Council (Jordan only) |
| - MBA Specializations.                                                                              |     |                            |
| - Other Specializations.                                                                            | 59  | 5                          |
|                                                                                                   |     | British Council (Jordan only) |

The accreditation of the French Language and German Language tests necessary for admission to postgraduate programs considers the following proficiency levels:

| Specializations                                 | German Language | French Language |
|------------------------------------------------|-----------------|-----------------|
| Language programs and their related fields      | B2              | B2              |
| (Translation…, etc.)                           |                 |                 |
| Scientific programs                             | B1              | B1              |
| Humanities programs                             | A2              | A2              |

**Please Note:**
1. The mentioned scores and levels were implemented beginning from the conclusion of the second semester of 2016/2017. This decision aligns with the decision made by the Higher Education Council of the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research during its fifth session on 18/2/2017.

2. In case applicants **do not** meet the requirements of any of the English language tests mentioned above, they are obliged to enroll in the **Equivalent English** course offered by the University of Jordan, which consists of 6 credit hours, except the programs requiring the mentioned English Language Tests as **special conditions** at the official study plans.
